render_nerf_dataset: render a NeRF dataset with 200 random camera views from a Blender scene to an output directory
listify_matrix: convert a Blender mathutils Matrix into a nested Python list of lists
parent_obj_to_camera: create an Empty object at the origin and parent a Blender camera to it
generate_transforms_json: generate a transforms.json file with camera transform matrices and file paths for each rendered frame
write_intrinsics: write camera intrinsics including focal length, principal point, and resolution to a text file
